vb_textbox.text: I would watch the colour of the characters giving you the most points. I found a purple character was giving me lots of points, so I stayed with that character for a while, until the situation changed. Also if you are on one side and you repeatedly get a high score, continue on that side - and if you are on one side and repeatedly get a low score, swap to the other side. If both sides are producing low scores, just swap sides till you achieve high scores again.
